commands.name: away
commands.description: unsets default working directory and allows running fep in current working directory

commands.name: heed
commands.description:
removes folders from the permanently ignored list
`ath cfg heed .git .idea .vscode`
or
`ath cfg heed --all`

commands.name: here
commands.description:
sets current working directory as a default working directory for future
uses with fep, untill it gets unset or new directory is set

commands.name: ignore
commands.description:
adds folders to the permanently ignored list
`ath cfg ignore .git .idea .vscode`

commands.name: to
commands.description:
sets timeout in seconds
`ath cfg to 30`
or disables timeout if passed 0 - same as nto
`ath cfg to 0`
